transcript.text: Hello, I'm here to help you get ready for your appointment. Could you tell me what has been bothering you?
I’ve been having trouble with my bowels — not going as often, and I have to strain quite a bit.

Could you tell me in your own words when this bowel trouble first started and how it came on — including anything that seemed to trigger it — and also whether you have any allergies or bad reactions to medicines?

It started about three weeks ago; I’m not sure what triggered it, though I started co-codamol for back pain about a month ago and have been drinking less to avoid getting up at night. I have no known drug allergies.
How much is this bowel trouble affecting your daily life at the moment — could you describe that in your own words?

The straining is uncomfortable — about a 4 out of 10 — and my lower tummy feels bloated, so I’d really like something to get things moving. I’m also a bit worried it could be something serious like bowel cancer.

Besides the co-codamol you started for back pain, are you taking or have you recently taken any other medicines — prescribed or bought without a prescription, such as painkillers, vitamins or herbal remedies — and do you use any non-tablet medicines like inhalers, eye drops, creams, injections or patches, at any time of day such as morning, evening or bedtime?

I also take apixaban 2.5 mg twice a day, bisoprolol 2.5 mg once a day, and a calcium and vitamin D chewable twice a day. I don’t use inhalers, eye drops, creams, injections or patches, and I haven’t taken other bought remedies.
Apart from your back pain, are there any other health conditions you see a doctor or nurse about regularly, or any past illnesses, operations or hospital stays you’d like to mention?
I have osteoarthritis in my spine and knees, and I have an irregular heartbeat — atrial fibrillation. I don’t have any operations or hospital stays I need to mention.
Since this started, have you noticed any changes in your appetite, sleep, weight or energy — or have none of those changed?
I haven’t noticed any changes in my appetite, sleep, weight or energy.
Is there anything else about your health in the past — other long-term conditions, past illnesses, operations or hospital stays — that you’d like to add?
No, I don’t have any other long-term conditions, past illnesses, operations or hospital stays to add.
Besides the bloating in your lower tummy, since this started have you noticed any changes in your bladder or bowel habits, or in your breathing, or anything else — or none of these?
I go most days, really; there’s no blood or black stools and no vomiting, and I haven’t noticed any bladder or breathing changes.
Thank you, that is very helpful. I have put together a short summary of what you told me. Please read it and tell me if anything should be corrected before it goes to your doctor.
